body:
[Supervisor] Round 1

CI is green on f8014a3 (CI 43617640383; PR policy 43617641119). The four CANCELLED jobs in 43617640438 are zero-step jobs that pr-policy's cancel-in-progress concurrency superseded on the same SHA, so they are not failures. pgTAP 035 ran on this head and passed. The SQL and the persist-before-deliver design are careful; the items below are what stands between this and approval.

**Blocking**

B1. src/platform/chat/http.ts:121-160. POST /api/chat has no exact-Origin or CSRF check. Plan §4.2 ("require exact Origin validation and CSRF protection for state-changing endpoints"), §9.2.1 (POST /api/chat: "exact origin/CSRF"), §9.4 requireExactOriginAndCsrf. The session is a cookie and company2 is same-site with company1; the body is parsed without checking content-type, so a cross-site text/plain POST runs a turn as the victim. Fix: refuse with 403 origin_mismatch unless Origin === new URL(request.url).origin (the precedent is src/platform/knowledge/upload-session.ts:251-256), require application/json or a host-bound CSRF token (src/platform/identity/csrf.ts), and add http.test.ts cases for missing, foreign and sibling-tenant Origin with zero session/runDeps calls.

B2. run-chat.ts:179-183; migration 20261113020000_chat_persistence.sql:1040-1066, 1150-1169, 1228-1239. A stored answer, quotedText included, is replayed on resume and history reads without re-checking the cited sources. Plan §4.4 ("Reauthorize dependencies before replay"), §6.2 ("Re-check source authorization for derived histories"), F17, §9.2.1. Fix: in chat_get_run_v1, chat_load_conversation_v1 and the resume branch, withhold the answer (closed `withheld`) when any agent_run_evidence.source_version_id fails source_version_is_readable; add the same predicate to the agent_run_evidence policy; add a pgTAP case that removes a4's Site A membership and shows that no quote comes back.

B3. migration:931-943; 035:597-601; run-chat.ts:182. answer_json keeps the caller's declared dataClass while agent_runs.data_class is raised, and the resume path delivers the lower class. AGENTS.md §4.4; packet Contract ("Answer.dataClass is stored"). Fix: store jsonb_set(p_answer,'{dataClass}',to_jsonb(v_class)), extend test 27 to assert answer_json->>'dataClass', and add a resume-class test in run-chat.test.ts.

B4. docs/tasks/T-104-chat-skeleton.md:84-120, :3, :76-82. The packet's Done evidence paragraph was replaced (COORDINATION §3: packet content changes go through the supervisor); the status line lacks "code complete; staging evidence owed" with the unblocking issue (§6a), and the owed run is not under T-004; the gateway-down box is ticked though its own text says it cannot close. Fix: restore the original Done evidence verbatim and keep the narrative in the PR body; fix the status line per §6a and add the T-004 entry; untick or split that box.

B5. src/platform/chat/experts.ts:40-93; page.tsx:38. The provisional expert `gpr-field-officer` is licensed by `uav-compliance` with a UAV prompt and its own model chains. That contradicts ruling #83 (uav-expert/gpr-expert; uav-compliance/gpr) and is T-311's (Lane 2) scope. Fix: wire NOT_WIRED_CATALOG in production and use a test-only catalog in tests; if you want an in-code expert for the skeleton, open needs-supervisor first, and use the #83 keys with a consistent service.

**Non-blocking**

N1. The PR body says composeAnswer comes from @/platform/gateway/compose; it is @/platform/agents/compose (run-chat.ts:5). Update the cited runs to f8014a3.
N2. permittedServiceKeys is [] today, so production answers 403 out_of_scope at experts.ts:180-187 before anything persists. Correct the "honest production behaviour" text (PR body, adapters.ts:36-39).
N3. stream.ts:62: allow an unpersisted answer frame only when status is refused or unavailable, not merely when it has no claims.
N4. 035 tests 64-66 use a3, who owns no rows. Add a suspended-owner case (a2): 28000 from load/get/list and zero rows from the plain SELECT.
N5. 035:909-912 says "under their own scope" but the scope was cleared at :907. Add a4-under-company2-scope reading company1 rows = 0 to pin the policy's organisation predicate.
N6. complete_run does not tie chunk_id or quotedText to the cited version. Note it as the verifier's job in docs/contracts/chat-persistence.md.
N7. policy_revision is stored but not re-compared at completion (§9.4). Note it as a follow-up.
N8. The doubled '' inside -- SQL comments (migration:155, 189, 196…) is cosmetic.
N9. page.tsx:38 lists experts without filtering by context grants or services (§9.1).
N10. Rebase note: seven open PRs also edit 001 rule 32, and 20261113020000 must be renamed if #143 or #179 merges first. #151 (refusal keys) should merge before this; then add `insufficient_support` and `refusalKey` to the fixtures and persist the key.

**Decisions I am taking separately** (no action from you yet): the plain-SSE/no-AI-SDK wire format against chat-protocol.md:8 and plan §9.2–9.3; the size waiver against AGENTS.md §5.7; and claiming with T-103/T-113/T-114 unmerged (COORDINATION §1.2).

Please reply to each item by its number after pushing, then re-request review. Approval must be on the final head (supabase/migrations/ is protected).

[Supervisor] Round 2 on head `6d8ed6c`

Round 1 B1–B5 are fixed, all six checks pass on this head (035 is plan(78)), and it merges onto `main` without a textual conflict. Three ordering items block. Each follows from something that merged or was ruled after your push.

**Verified**
- B1: `http.ts:92-96, :143` refuses a missing or non-matching `Origin` and a non-JSON content type before any body, session or run work. `http.test.ts:136-148` pins zero session and `runDeps` calls.
- B2: `chat_run_answer_withheld` (`migration:1009-1018`) checks every cited version with `source_version_is_readable`. The run and history reads return `withheld` with a null answer (`:1086-1088, :1191-1193`), and the `agent_run_evidence` policy carries the same predicate (`:1275`). Tests 77-78 cover the mixed-class run.
- B3: `answer_json` stores the raised class (`:936`).
- B4: the Status line uses the §6a wording and names T-004.
- B5: production wires `NOT_WIRED_CATALOG` (`adapters.ts:205`).
- All four new tables have RLS enabled.

**Blocking**

B6. `src/app/(tenant)/chat/page.tsx:26, :40` — #173 merged on 2026-11-20, and its shell renders the page's `<main>`. This page still renders its own, so `/chat` would have two main landmarks (the 2026-11-18 coordination note, #173 Round 2 N13). Fix: rebase and change both to a `<div>` or `<section>`, with a test that the page renders no `main`.

B7. `supabase/migrations/20261119100000_chat_persistence.sql` — COORDINATION §3. `main` now holds `20261120165000_brand_public_host_guard.sql` (#211). Rename to a fresh UTC timestamp when you rebase.

B8. Merge order with #151 (unchanged from Round 1 N10 and the 2026-11-18 note): #151 merges first. Then `refusedAnswer()` gains a `refusalKey` that matches its status, the test catalog gains `insufficient_support`, and the key is persisted with the answer row. `run-chat.ts` has no `refusalKey` today. #151 is one small change away (its Round 2 B5), and that change also makes the `insufficient_support` path return platform-authored `unknowns`, so check your fixtures against it.

**Non-blocking**

N11. `PROVISIONAL_EXPERTS` still lives in `src/platform/chat/experts.ts:40-93`, a production module, with the key and service pairing that #83 rules out (`gpr-field-officer` under `uav-compliance`). It is reachable only from tests. Move it into `chat-fixtures.ts` and give it #83-consistent keys, so nobody wires it by accident.
N12. Please reply by number on Round 1 N1–N9. Your last comments cover the CI fixes only (COORDINATION §5).

D1 (the AI SDK wire format as a stacked PR), D2 and D3 stand as ruled on 2026-11-18.

[Supervisor] Round 3 on head `3f53e89`

**Verified**
- B6: both `/chat` wrappers are `<section aria-labelledby="chat-heading">`, and the page drops the font and colour the shell owns. `page.landmark.test.tsx` asserts that neither the ready path nor the blocked path renders a `main`.
- B7: the migration is `20261120216000_chat_persistence.sql`, the newest in the queue, and its header and doc references are updated.
- N12: Round 1 N1–N9 are answered by number.

**Blocking**

B8 (unchanged). This is the #151 merge order. #151 is now ready to approve. When it merges, rebase onto it, add `refusalKey` to `refusedAnswer()`, add `insufficient_support` to the test catalog, and persist the key with the answer row.

B9. `database` fails only on "Generated types are up to date" ([run 44826774253](https://github.com/TerraOI/TerraOI/actions/runs/44826774253)). Take the types from the run on your post-#151 head, not this one (FAQ-0009).

**Merge order:** this PR is last among the open migration PRs (#207 → #160 → #149 → #197 → #193 → #179 → #178). Each one commits `database.types.ts`, so rebase and re-take the types after the PRs ahead of you merge.

N11 stands as a follow-up.
